messages:
Sophia: Heads-up — sample-app started throwing in Next.js edge functions after I published @redwood/sdk 2.1.0 with the new exports map. Repro pretty quick.
Gabe: Seen failures in staging too. Stack trace points at module resolution: `Error: No matching export` coming from the runtime trying to resolve `./dist/index.js` vs `./dist/index.mjs`.
Sophia: Repro steps:
1) `git clone` sample-app
2) `npm i @redwood/sdk@2.1.0`
3) `next dev --experimental-edge`
4) navigate to /api/edge -> runtime throws

Here is the `exports` snippet we shipped:
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
    "default": "./dist/index.cjs",
    "node": "./dist/index.js"
  },
  "./browser": "./dist/index.mjs"
}
```
Sophia: Looks like the edge import uses the `import` resolver and prefers `module`/.mjs but we only put `browser` for .mjs. Edge doesn't match `browser` condition.
Alex: The ordering and conditional names matter. For edge (V8 isolates) `import` condition is usually satisfied by `module` or a top-level `import` entry, not `default` or `node`. You can add an `import` key that points to `./dist/index.mjs` and it should fix resolution in edge runtimes.
Marie: Also noticed TS types disappeared for consumers — `types` being inside the conditional might confuse `tsc` depending on the package manager. We should keep a top-level "types" field too.
ci-bot: CI: e2e-edge-tests failed on canary after SDK update. Run: https://ci.example.com/runs/2345 :x:
Gabe: Short-term workaround for sample-apps: add a compatibility wrapper in app `node_modules/@redwood/sdk/index.mjs` with `export * from './dist/index.mjs'` or pin @redwood/sdk@2.0.x.
Sophia: @Alex can you cut a 2.1.1 with `import` condition + top-level `types`? We should also add a minimal edge smoke test to prevent regressions.
Alex: Yep. I'll open a PR to reorder `exports` and add `"import": "./dist/index.mjs"` plus a top-level `types` pointing at `dist/index.d.ts`. Will add a CI job that runs Next.js edge dev smoke test.
Marie: I'll prepare the types PR and add `typesVersions` mapping so older TS resolves to the right d.ts.
Gabe: :thumbsup: target a patch release today and add a small changelog note about `exports` and edge compatibility. Also add a short entry in the migration guide for users who hit the issue.
Sophia: Thanks all — will update sample-apps repo with the workaround info so on-call doesn't get paged again.
